text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angola's interior minister Santana Andre Pitra said about 30,000 Rwandan refugees were reported to be approaching the Angolan border.
- The European Union has pledged $17 million towards the rebuilding of infrastructure in central Bie province.
- An African Investment Bank source said privatisation of the Angolan Popular Development Bank was not a priority in 1997.
